harnessFiles.description: The dependency manifests, lock files and test configuration files (for example package.json, tsconfig.json, jest.config.js, pyproject.toml, Taskfile.yml) you changed only so the tests run, relative to the tree; each is also in changedFiles. Regression verification replays a failing test of an existing requirement on the code before this Task with only the test and harness files added, a manifest or configuration file you list in changedFiles and not here is a product change the replay keeps as it was before the change, and one a test writer also declared then leaves the replay unproven. Never name a file whose change the product needs, such as a dependency the product code imports.
